# GarvinLabs

> GarvinLabs connects businesses with qualified service providers when
> they're actively looking to buy. It identifies companies with a live need
> (an OSHA citation or inspection, a new commercial lease, a warehouse
> expansion), checks the opportunity matches the provider's services, and
> introduces the provider directly to the buyer.

GarvinLabs is founded by Garvin Chanderia, whose background is enterprise
architecture and analytics: CXO-level enterprise architecture consulting, and
BI development on plant and ERP data at Cummins.

## Markets

- Safety and compliance: businesses facing OSHA citations, inspections or
  corrective action, introduced to OSHA, EHS and workplace safety consultants
- Commercial build-outs: companies signing leases, relocating or opening new
  offices, introduced to fit-out, tenant-improvement and design-build contractors
- Warehouse automation: distribution centers, 3PLs and fulfillment operations
  that are expanding or modernizing, introduced to warehouse automation and
  material-handling integrators

## How it works

1. Identify companies actively buying, from public signals (OSHA inspections,
   new commercial leases, distribution center announcements).
2. Check whether the opportunity matches the provider's services (need, size,
   location). Opportunities that don't fit are never sent.
3. Introduce the provider directly to the person making the decision.
